description: Calculate a suggested tip and total for a bill using Tipping Rules destination norms (percent or round-up). Returns amounts plus canonical destination and calculator URLs.

bill.description: Bill amount in local currency units (positive number).

country.description: Country slug or name for local tipping norms.

service.description: Service category. Prefer restaurant, bar, taxi, delivery, hotelStaff, or tourGuides.

name: calculate_tip

bill.description: Bill amount in local currency units.

calculatorUrl.description: Deep link to the on-site calculator for this country.

currency.description: ISO currency code when known (e.g. EUR, USD).

lastReviewed.description: ISO date when guidance was last reviewed, when available.

methodologyUrl.description: How Tipping Rules reviews and sources guidance.

mode.description: Calculation mode applied for this service and destination.

ok.description: True when the tip was calculated.

recommendation.description: Human-readable norm string for the selected service.

service.description: Service category label used for the calculation.

tipAmount.description: Suggested tip amount in local currency units.

tipPercent.description: Applied tip percent when mode is percent; null for round-up.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g. NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION, TIMEOUT).

ok.description: False when the tool could not complete successfully.

outputSchema.description: Tip calculation result or a structured error.

title: Calculate tip
